_rfb._tcp.description: VNC (RFB protocol) remote desktop has known authentication bypass and RCE vulnerabilities.

_vnc._tcp.description: VNC remote desktop has known authentication bypass and RCE vulnerabilities.

_ftp._tcp.description: FTP transmits credentials in cleartext. Multiple FTP servers have critical known vulnerabilities.

_ssh._tcp.description: SSH provides encrypted remote shell access. Ensure key-based authentication is enforced.

_remotemanagement._tcp.description: Apple Remote Desktop management allows full screen sharing and remote control.

_smb._tcp.description: SMB file sharing has a history of critical vulnerabilities. Keep firmware and OS updated.

ASUS.description: ASUS router firmware has known critical RCE vulnerabilities in recent versions.

Cisco.description: Cisco IOS XE has a critical privilege escalation vulnerability in the web management UI.

D-Link.description: D-Link router firmware has known RCE vulnerabilities.

Netgear.description: Netgear routers have authentication bypass vulnerabilities in certain firmware versions.

CVE-2020-10188.title: Telnet Server Buffer Overflow (netkit telnetd)
CVE-2020-10188.description: netkit telnetd through 0.17, used by many embedded devices, has a buffer overflow that lets a remote attacker execute code.

CVE-2019-15681.title: LibVNCServer Memory Disclosure
CVE-2019-15681.description: LibVNCServer before a 2019 fix leaks stack memory to remote clients, which can expose data and help chain other exploits.

CVE-2006-2369.title: RealVNC Authentication Bypass
CVE-2006-2369.description: RealVNC 4.1.1 and products built on it let a remote client skip authentication by requesting an insecure security type.

CVE-2011-2523.title: vsftpd 2.3.4 Backdoor
CVE-2011-2523.description: A tampered vsftpd 2.3.4 release distributed in mid-2011 contains a backdoor that opens a remote shell.

CVE-2023-39238.title: ASUS Router Format String Vulnerability
CVE-2023-39238.description: A format string flaw in some ASUS router firmware (e.g. RT-AX56U V2) lets an attacker with admin access run code or crash the device.

CVE-2021-45514.title: NETGEAR Router Command Injection
CVE-2021-45514.description: Some NETGEAR routers (e.g. XR1000 before firmware 1.0.0.58) allow unauthenticated command injection.

CVE-2023-44415.title: D-Link Router Command Injection
CVE-2023-44415.description: Some D-Link routers (e.g. DIR-1260, DIR-2150) let attackers on the local network run code via command injection.
